sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Requires the Hideout module "Lavatory" to be used
- Used to repair armored items
- Cannot be used in raid
- Usage increases the Light Vests or Heavy Vests skill, depending on the type of armor repaired

sections.heading: Quest Rewards
sections.text: - 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from Battery Change

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: Body armor repair kits share their spawn locations with Weapon repair kits.
